Standard: The seat pan acceleration time history generated in system-level ejection sled or in-flight tests at ambient conditions, do not yield a DRIz value in excess of 22.0 IAW the limits within INFO PUB ASM 4048 Ed 2v2, Ejection Acceleration Limits. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Data from full system-level dynamic ejection sled testing is analyzed to show compliance with the standard. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Full system-level dynamic ejection sled testing is used to show compliance with the standard.
